_comment: The 64kcap naive GRPO run with every change from step 0 (no mid-run changes): 64k context enforced at rollout, end-at-limit (PLATOON_MIN_COMPLETION_TOKENS 2048), TITO stitching + Qwen3.5 keep-thinking template (platoon-tito2 venv, PRs #65/#66), 64 tool-call cap (micro-swe-agent step_limit, TMax 4B), remote sandboxes (6 rt_HC x 96 + 112 local, 640 concurrent), sysdeps bundle instead of per-trial apt, TP2 + expandable segments, no KL, online W&B, recovery checkpoints every 5 steps, driver stall guard (2700 s without a step: stack dump, stop, driver restart from the latest recovery checkpoint; at most 3 auto-restarts).

labels.context: 65536 enforced at rollout; a call cut at the window ends the trajectory (end-at-limit)
labels.toolcap: 64 tool calls from step 0 (micro-swe-agent agent.step_limit 64); matches TMax 4B
labels.prompts: TITO stitching + Qwen3.5 keep-thinking template (platoon-tito2 venv) from step 0
labels.rollout: external: n4hf72 nodes 1-3; sandboxes: 6 rt_HC hosts x 96 + 112 local, 640 concurrent
labels.compares_to: grpo200-tmax-naive-4node-64k--Qwen3.5-4B (rollouts uncapped at 262k, training truncated to 64k; KL 0.01)
